# Third-party: console-survival-card (wave 4 slot 408)

No new dependencies and no copied code. The card uses only `std` and the existing in-repo
`console-ui` helpers (`json`, `html::esc`, `pages::bank::span`, `pages::p4::zagreb`,
`pages::security::parse_iso`). Cargo.lock unchanged. Hermes was not used.
